Game Overview

In Paint the Frog, the core idea is straightforward: dive into rapid-fire fun with Paint the Frog, where quick reflexes are key. Match and paint frogs, collecting coins along the way. Strategize with power-ups like Extra Time and Magnet for a colorful, coin-fuelled challenge. Improve your speed and reactions with each vibrant, frog-filled level.
